name: VECTOR_FINISH_LINE_REHEARSAL_V1
purpose: Continuously simulate each built capability acting as the finished customer product, walk all remaining steps to completion, expose real repository/proof blockers early, and rehearse realistic future failure conditions without treating simulation as proof.

completionStages.actsAs: Capability code/configuration exists with deterministic contracts and tests.
Capability is assembled into the exact release candidate and executes its admission tests.
Exact candidate starts in the hosted environment and exposes healthy runtime behavior.
A real role signs in, reaches the capability, reads authoritative state and performs the intended safe workflow.
The outcome survives refresh, logout and a fresh authenticated session.
The outcome and audit survive restart/recovery; incomplete actions reconcile safely.
Tenant, identity, authority, replay, corruption and hostile-input cases fail closed.
The customer sees a clear useful experience, verified outcome, value and recovery explanation.
Independent evidence admits the exact artifact for promotion without simulation being counted as proof.

scenarioCatalogue.expected: degrade or contain; keep safe service; preserve evidence; recover without duplicate effects
reduce autonomy; surface uncertainty; never manufacture truth
recover from durable state; verify once; no duplicate business effect
contain and preserve known-good evidence; no false success
deny before mutation and preserve forensic evidence
safe recovery path without weakening authentication or tenant boundaries
lower authority; maintain minimum safe service; no blind consequential action
negotiate or quarantine changed schema; no silent reinterpretation
fallback import/manual evidence path still reaches safe operational readiness
buffer/reconcile safely; weak evidence cannot stop pay
fail closed on export, explain smallest required action, preserve deadline context
deterministic safe runbook/fallback; model absence cannot remove core controls
quarantine untrusted context; no tool/authority escalation
known recovery/failover path; exact tenant/data-residency rules remain enforced
record correction as evidence, invalidate stale inference, learn proposal-only
